name: UpdateOrderReference
description: Update the customer purchase order (PO) reference number on an existing sales order in the SAP ERP system. Trigger this function when the user wants to change, correct, or set the PO reference, customer reference, or external document number of a specific order. Requires both the order ID and the new reference value.

order_id.description: The unique sales order identifier in SAP (e.g., 'ORD-123456' or '0000005001') whose reference number will be updated.

new_reference.description: The new reference number or customer PO number to set on the sales order (e.g. 'PO-2026-0042').
